structure.unit: General Provisions Relating to Social Services

law.catch_line: Failure to obey subpoena or charging illegal fees; penalty
law.text: If any person fails or refuses to obey any subpoena issued under the provisions of § 63.2-220 or § 63.2-322, or charges or receives any fee contrary to the provisions of § 63.2-508, he shall be guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor.
